В данном задании вам необходимо исследов: In this task, you need to study the motion of the ball during immersion (you can fix the second ball at the free end of the thread on the stand). Make sure the fishing line does not touch the walls of the measuring cylinder. Take measurements only when the ball is fully immersed in the soap.
В этой части вам необходимо исследовать: In this part, you need to study the rising of the ball under the action of the second ball as a counterweight. Assume the ball rises at a constant speed. You do not need to study the law of motion – just measure the average rising speed. The mass of the counterweight can be increased by attaching paper clips. Indicate the height interval over which you conducted the measurements.
Внимательно продумывайте последовательно: Carefully plan the sequence of experiments; they require patience and sufficient time. To measure the motion law, it is convenient to use a stopwatch with lap memory. If you do not know how to use this mode, consult the organizers.
Для измерения расстояний пользуйтесь шка: Use the scale of the graduated cylinder to measure distances. The goal of this task is to study the nature of the dependencies, so the unit of length measurement does not matter—let this unit be a “scale unit” corresponding to a volume change of {#0} ml (denote this unit as “divisions”).
Жидкое мыло является неньютоновской жидк: Liquid soap is a non-Newtonian fluid for which Newton's law of viscosity does not apply. In this task, you need to study the motion of plasticine balls in such a fluid. Do not be surprised by the results obtained; they may be unexpected for you.
Закрепите блок в лапке штатива, через бл: Secure the pulley in the clamp of the stand, thread the fishing line through the pulley, and attach two identical plasticine balls (approximately {#0} mm in diameter) to the ends of the line. One of the balls should be immersed in a graduated cylinder filled with liquid soap. You need to study the motion of this ball both when rising and when descending. The other ball moving in the air will be called the counterweight ball.
Используйте секундомер с памятью этапов: Use a stopwatch with lap memory – record the times when the ball passes certain depth marks.
